work.description: A widely circulated evangelical answer page that rejects the folded-napkin claim. Registered because its wording closely follows the TruthOrFiction assessment, including the estimate that the claim originated in 2007, and because it is the route by which that estimate reached much later apologetic writing.
work.title: What is the significance of the folded napkin in Christ's tomb after the resurrection?
